## Summary

Head of Data Analytics with experience in growing teams, developing novel data products and driving business value through data solutions. I specialise in data warehousing, data governance and end-to-end data solutions. I love ensuring that data teams work on the right things and seize opportunities, all while setting a high bar for quality. I'm comfortable across the whole path from raw data to the final report or data tool. I write publicly at [High SQL](https://highsql.substack.com) as well as [alaburda.github.io](https://alaburda.github.io).

## Experience

### Head of Data Analytics - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
2021 November – present · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Own the data function for Ignitis Lithuania and Latvia: the data platform and
warehouse, the BI practice, data governance, and the team's structure, hiring and
roadmap. Accountable for turning business demand into data products and for the
standards the organisation's reporting rests on.

- Scaled a team of 5 data analysts to a data platform team of 18 people, consisting of Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Data Scientists
- Drove Power BI adoption across Ignitis Lithuania and Latvia, resulting in virtually the whole organisation relying on data reports on a daily basis
- Established a Data Governance program to increase data quality, reduce time to solving data quality issues and avert issues before changes are deployed
- Established multiple data products in the organisation, including:
    - A smart meter API service serving over 900 thousand households at sub-100 ms latency
    - A physical address service used by other internal systems as a source of truth
    - An internal AI agent helping customer support employees
- Drove GitHub Copilot adoption in the organisation by organising trainings and holding a monthly AI Ambassador meetup

### Senior Data Analyst - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
April 2021 – November 2021 · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Retail customer analytics, alongside backlog management and delegating work to
two direct reports.

### Data Analyst - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
2019 – 2021 · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Met the business's reporting needs: built and maintained Power BI dashboards,
combined data from SQL databases and API endpoints, and ran ETL pipelines in R,
Python and Power Automate.

- Introduced version control to the team and put the analytical codebase under versioning
- Built an internal R library that packaged routine analytical work into reusable functions

### Data Analyst - Aon

::: {.cv-meta}
2018 – 2019 · Chicago, United States · Internship, Global Claims team
:::

Supported the Global Claims team with data preparation, quality control and
reporting across global claims data.

- Built ETL pipelines and quality control tooling in R for global claims data
- Maintained the team's internal SQL Server instance
- Created interactive Tableau dashboards for claims reporting
